chronology.training: eligible certified UFC STANDARD_FINISH 2015+ strictly prior years

convergence.scope: all stochastic alpha,beta,tau,z; all folds must pass before aggregate interpretation

evaluation.classification: CLEAR_SUCCESS only concordant favorable bootstrap evidence, persistence, and no dominant generalization damage; INCONCLUSIVE mixed/uncertain; CURRENT_SPECIFICATION_NOT_SUPPORTED adverse evidence; no numeric success cutoff
evaluation.panels: immutable terrain, #111 six bands, unchanged #113 archetypes/thresholds (evaluation only)
evaluation.tradeoff: negative paired log-loss delta HELPED; positive HURT; abs<=1e-12 UNCHANGED, descriptive only; probability buckets use paired baseline-MIN membership for quality deltas and own membership for reliability

model: Bayesian Bernoulli logistic, noncentered independent zero-mean Normal group deviations; learned shared scale per family
prediction: mean sigmoid of posterior logits, 95% equal-tailed credible intervals; unseen training groups use independent standard-normal draws at learned scale with fixed prediction seed
preprocessing: reuse unchanged SurfacePreprocessor MOV0_MIN; slice off weight one-hot columns, keep numeric and title; fit within outer training only

priors.global_beta: Normal(0,0.5) independently for all standardized numeric columns and title indicator
priors.tau_family: HalfNormal(0.5) independently for each of four families
priors.z_group_effect: Normal(0,1); deviation=tau*z; group effects not constrained to sum zero

reproducibility: exact software lock; fixed seeds, sorted fights, BLAS threads=1; repeat first H1 fold and require identical prediction/draw hashes under same environment before accepting results; cross-platform bitwise equality not promised

sampling.retry: none; stop on convergence failure, do not tune after results

shrinkage: local information diagnostic lambda=1/(1+tau^2*I_group), I=sum(p*(1-p)*x_effect^2) training posterior mean, x=1 for intercept. Approximate conditional pooling weight, not observed ratio to unpooled fits; no independent class model
